## Description

<!-- Describe your changes in detail. Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature / component (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI improvements
- [ ] 🌐 Language profile / Resource addition

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`ruff check` and `ruff format` pass).
- [ ] I have added type annotations for all public functions/classes (`mypy` passes).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest` with >=80% coverage).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] If introducing voice data, consent basis and licensing are explicitly documented in `provenance`.
- [ ] If adding an extension/component, a valid `lingualdub.manifest.json` is provided and tested.
